source.tool: Node UDP probe (this project's scratch script): sends the text M99999 once to 192.0.2.10:3000 and records the first reply; read-only
source.printerState: not read; discovery replies do not carry state
source.note: Frame 1 is the probe as sent (a plain-text datagram, not JSON). Frame 2 is the reply datagram, parsed from JSON; the reply came from the probed address, source port 3000. LAN IP redacted to 192.0.2.10; the reply has no MAC and no file names.
